option_fields.name: header
option_fields.description: write column names above each result set

option_fields.name: max_rows_per_sheet
option_fields.description: rows per sheet before continuing on `Name (2)`; Excel's limit less a header

option_fields.name: columns
option_fields.description: per column name, on any sheet: `{format: <Excel number format>, formula: "={a}*{b}", total: sum}`; a query entry's `columns` wins

option_fields.name: autofit
option_fields.description: size each column from its content (at most 60 characters); a query entry's `autofit` and a column's `width` win

option_fields.name: style
option_fields.description: how sheets look: `font`, `header`, `totals`, `banded_rows`, `borders`, and cell keys (`bold`, `fill`, ...) for every data cell; a query entry's `style` and a column's win

option_fields.name: totals_label
option_fields.description: text in the first column of a totals row, when that column has no total

option_fields.name: date_format
option_fields.description: Excel number format for date columns

option_fields.name: datetime_format
option_fields.description: Excel number format for timestamp columns

option_fields.name: time_format
option_fields.description: Excel number format for time columns
